11. A tool call is one of the defined write tool calls and carries typed parameters.
12. A call to apply a refund of any type requires that the affected customer exists in the database.
13. A call to apply a refund of any type requires that the affected account exists in the database.
14. A call to apply a refund of any type requires that the referenced transaction exists in the database.
15. A call to apply a refund of any type requires that the referenced transaction has status POSTED.
16. A call to apply a refund of any type is not permitted if the affected customer's KYC status is FAILED.
17. A call to apply a refund of any type is not permitted if the affected account has its has sanctions block flag set to true.
18. A call to apply a refund of type MERCHANT_REFUND with an amount greater than the referenced transaction's amount is not permitted.
19. A call to apply a refund of type GOODWILL_CREDIT with an amount greater than ten thousand pence is not permitted.
20. A call to apply a refund of type GOODWILL_CREDIT is not permitted if the sum of the customer's recent goodwill credit total and the proposed amount exceeds fifty thousand pence.
